survivors.description: Off-by-one in prefix slicing leaves the colon in the payload to decode.
survivors.diff:
--- a/virtualizarr/parsers/kerchunk/translator.py
+++ b/virtualizarr/parsers/kerchunk/translator.py
@@ -222,3 +222,3 @@
             if raw.startswith(b"base64:"):
-                data = base64.b64decode(raw[len(b"base64:") :])
+                data = base64.b64decode(raw[len(b"base64:") - 1 :])
             else:
